thme_full_split_pass.note: tokens per second counts the 303,118 scored tokens in 297 windows of 1,024 with the loss head; weights resident, zero re-uploads; GPU memory peak is nvidia-smi total memory used (includes the 1,154 MiB idle desktop baseline)

comparable.is: same model, same GPU, same weight formats (THME stores F16, Q8_0 or Q4_0 weights, its arithmetic is f32), all weights resident on the GPU, no CPU involvement in either
is_not: llama-bench pp1024 is one batch of 1,024 tokens; THME streams 297 windows of 1,024 and computes full-vocabulary logits and cross-entropy for every position, while llama.cpp prompt processing computes logits for the last token only
different kernels and APIs: llama.cpp CUDA and Vulkan (cooperative-matrix path on this driver) against THME's wgpu Vulkan kernels with f32 arithmetic
both ran on a machine with other sessions active (see load_log)
comparable.token_generation: llama-bench tg128 is single-token decoding; THME has no timed decode path measured on this model yet, so the tg numbers have no THME counterpart
